name: – Anna Strolenberg – After § 33 – Am 53
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 33a. Emphasises that the implementation and enforcement of this regulation must fully respect the freedom of expression, media pluralism and the freedom of opinion, and must not result in disproportionate restrictions or indirect censorship of lawful content, including content that may be controversial, dissenting, or challenging to prevailing views in democratic debate;
